# Nexura

> Nexura is an Apache-2.0-licensed, typed Python SDK for operational AI agents and approval-gated workflows. `nexura-agents` (import `nexura_agents`, needs only httpx and pydantic) has agents, tools, teams, handoffs, structured output, human approval, budgets, durable runs and `FakeModel` for offline tests. `nexura-runtime` (import `nexura_runtime`) adds durable workflows, RAG, evaluations, a local REST service and a browser Studio. The project is alpha and not yet on PyPI: install from the repository. The open-source edition is single user, on one machine.

Every Python example in the docs runs offline with `FakeModel`, a scripted model, and is executed by the test suite. A model string such as `"openai:gpt-4.1-mini"` swaps in a real provider. The full text of every page below is in [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/llms-full.txt). Guidance for AI coding agents is in [skills/nexura/SKILL.md](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/skills/nexura/SKILL.md).

## Start here

- [Documentation index](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/README.md): every guide, grouped by task.
- [Quickstart in 10 minutes](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/quickstart-10-minutes.md): install, an agent, an approval, a budget and an approval-gated workflow resumed after a restart.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): install, first agent and first tool.
- [Project templates](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/project-templates.md): `nexura-runtime init` (agent, workflow, rag), `dev` (local service and Studio) and `deploy --target docker`.
- [Packages and installation](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/packages.md): the Python packages, source and wheel installs, supported versions.
- [Agents](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/agents.md): instructions, dependencies, sessions, agents as tools, handoffs, streaming, cancelling.
- [Testing your agents](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/testing.md): `FakeModel`, scripted tool calls, assertions, `agent.override(model=...)`.

## Build agents

- [Harness](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/harness.md): opt-in SKILL.md directories, context compaction, durable todo state and scoped filesystems for parent/child agents.
- [Tools](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/tools.md): function tools, typed dependencies, retries, timeouts, caching, hiding tools per run.
- [Structured output](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/structured-output.md): Pydantic output types, output validators, streaming partial output.
- [Human approval](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/approvals.md): pause before a tool runs, save the pause as JSON, approve, reject or edit, bind approval to the exact arguments.
- [Teams](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/teams.md): sequential, parallel and loop agents, group chat, approvals that pass through.
- [Guardrails, hooks and limits](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/guardrails-hooks-limits.md): input, output and tool guardrails, lifecycle hooks, `UsageLimits`.
- [Guardrails package](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/guardrails-package.md): `nexura-guardrails`, an LLM judge that fails closed, fast pre-filters, tiered and parallel checks, a category taxonomy.
- [Guardrail policy](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/guardrail-policy.md): declarative guardrail policy for every agent run, allowlist mode, approval gates, journaled verdicts, audit and service enforcement.
- [Budgets and usage](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/budgets-and-usage.md): token and cost accounting, budgets that reserve before each model call.
- [Durable runs](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/durable-runs.md): checkpoint agent runs and recover them after a crash, tool effect classes.
- [Models and providers](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/providers.md): OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Vertex AI, Sarvam, Ollama, LiteLLM, retries, fallbacks, rate limits.
- [MCP and OpenAPI tools](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/mcp-and-openapi.md): use MCP servers and REST APIs as tools.
- [Connectors](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/connectors.md): 15 integrations as workflow modules; writes need approval.
- [Long-term memory](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/memory.md): facts agents remember across sessions, one namespace per user.
- [Versioned prompts](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/prompts.md): prompts outside code with versions, labels and promotion.
- [Skills](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/skills.md): versioned instruction bundles an agent loads on demand.
- [Images, documents and audio](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/multimodal.md): attachments for each provider.
- [Evaluating agents and teams](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/evals.md): cases, scorers, LLM judge, reports and CI checks, offline.
- [Reproducing failures](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/reproducing-failures.md): portable recordings and offline replay.
- [Serving agents over MCP](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/serving-over-mcp.md): make agents usable from MCP clients.
- [Agent2Agent (A2A)](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/a2a.md): serve agents over A2A and call remote A2A agents as tools.
- [Observability](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/observability.md): OpenTelemetry traces for agents and workflows.

## Workflows and the local service

- [Workflows](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/workflows.md): durable graphs with approval gates, retries, `interrupt()`, history and fork, sub-workflows, parallel steps.
- [Durable execution contract](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/durable-execution.md): leases, step intents, effect classes and recovery rules.
- [Knowledge](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/knowledge.md): ingest files, hybrid keyword and vector search, citations.
- [Starter templates](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/templates.md): tested, offline-runnable workflows.
- [Service and Studio](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/studio-and-service.md): the local REST API, TypeScript client and browser Studio.
- [Streaming to frontends](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/streaming-to-frontends.md): AG-UI and AI SDK UI message SSE, negotiation, approvals and replay.
- [Run Nexura on a server (single operator)](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/remote-single-operator.md): remote single-operator mode with one operator token behind a TLS reverse proxy.
- [Use the hosted Nexura app](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/hosted.md): workspace API keys, CLI login and push, and sending SDK traces to a hosted workspace.
- [Agents in Studio](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/agents-in-studio.md): saved workspace agents, chat, evals and red-team.
- [Credentials and local secrets](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/local-secrets.md): credential references and the local encrypted secrets file.
- [Extending the service and Studio](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/extensions.md): auth providers, service extensions, entry points.
- [Importing Langflow flows](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/langflow-import.md): run saved Langflow flows on the SDK.
- [Production gVisor profile](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/sandbox-production.md): the hardened gvisor_production code sandbox, the operator checklist and the host preflight.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): common errors and what they mean.

## Migrating

- [From LangGraph](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/migrating-from-langgraph.md): graphs, checkpointers, `interrupt()`, history and fork mapped to workflows.
- [From Pydantic AI](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/migrating-from-pydantic-ai.md): agents, tools, deferred tool approvals, testing and durable execution.
- [From CrewAI](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/migrating-from-crewai.md): crews mapped to agents and teams, flows mapped to workflows.
- [From OpenAI Agent Builder and Evals](https://github.com/Liceron/nexura/blob/main/docs/migrating-from-openai.md): the Agents SDK concept map and importing OpenAI Evals data.
